name: JMAP Connect
subtitle: Fast, native email over JMAP
promotionalText: A fast, native email app for your Fastmail account on Mac, iPhone and iPad. No ads, no tracking, completely free.
description:
JMAP Connect is an independent, high speed email app built for Apple devices. It's written in SwiftUI, Apple's own toolkit, and talks to your Fastmail account over JMAP, the modern open email standard Fastmail runs on. The result is quick syncing, effortless navigation and a clean interface that feels right at home on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

FAST BY DESIGN
• On Mac, Fastmail tells the app the moment a message arrives
• Only what changed is fetched, so your inbox stays quick on patchy mobile data
• Search runs on Fastmail's servers and looks through every folder, finding every email you've kept, even from years ago

EVERYTHING YOU NEED, NOTHING YOU DON'T
• A familiar three pane layout: folders, conversations and the open email
• Every Fastmail account in one colour coded inbox
• Reply, reply all and forward, with your Fastmail signatures added for you
• Send from any of your addresses, including catch all addresses on your own domain
• A default From address and Reply to address for each one
• Drafts saved to your Fastmail Drafts folder
• Mark as spam and Not spam, which teach Fastmail's spam filter
• Works whether you use folders or labels in Fastmail
• Attachments, photos and document previews
• Drag emails into folders, create and rename folders, fold subfolders away
• Alerts and an unread count on the app icon

TRULY NATIVE
On Mac: a full Message menu and keyboard shortcuts, and any email opens in its own window. On iPhone: swipe to archive, delete or mark as read. On iPad: a three column layout with drag and drop.

PRIVATE
• Your device talks straight to Fastmail. There's no JMAP Connect server in the middle, so we never store, pass on or see your messages
• You sign in with a Fastmail API token, never your password, and you can switch it off with one click
• The token is kept in your device's Keychain
• Block pictures from the web so marketing trackers can't tell when you open an email
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking

TRY IT FIRST
No account yet? Choose Try it with sample mail on the welcome screen to look around with made up emails.

SET UP IN TWO MINUTES
Create an API token in Fastmail's settings, paste it in and your folders, signatures and inbox load straight away. Step by step guide at jmapconnect.app.

Works with every Fastmail plan, including your own domain.

JMAP Connect is an independent app created by Paul O'Brien. It isn't made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Fastmail. Fastmail is a trademark of Fastmail Pty Ltd.

review.notes:
SCREEN RECORDING
A screen recording from an iPhone on the latest iOS is attached to this App Review Information. It starts at launch, shows the sample mail tour, then signing in to a real Fastmail account with an API token, reading and searching real mail, and removing the account.

1. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
JMAP Connect is a free email app for people who use Fastmail, a paid email service. Fastmail has its own app, but many of its customers want a fast, native app that feels at home on iPhone, iPad and Mac. JMAP Connect talks to Fastmail over JMAP, the open email standard Fastmail runs on (RFC 8620 and RFC 8621), so mail loads quickly and only what changed is fetched. It has no ads, no tracking and no in app purchases.

2. HOW TO USE IT (NO ACCOUNT NEEDED)
- Open the app and tap Try it with sample mail on the welcome screen. This loads made up emails that live only inside the app; nothing is sent anywhere.
- Every main feature works with sample mail: the inbox and folders, opening a conversation, reply, reply all, forward, new message, attachments, star, archive, move, delete, mark as spam, search (it looks in every folder), and Settings (signatures, default From address, notifications).
- To leave sample mail, open Settings and tap Remove next to Sample mail.
- Real accounts: tap Add your Fastmail account and paste a Fastmail API token. The app never asks for a password. Fastmail customers make a token in Fastmail under Settings, Privacy & Security, Manage API tokens. We can't provide a demo Fastmail login because Fastmail sign ups need a verified phone number, which is why sample mail exists.
- Accounts: the app does not create accounts. People add an existing Fastmail account and can remove it at any time in Settings, which deletes its token from the Keychain and its data from the device.

3. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Fastmail's JMAP API (api.fastmail.com), the only service the app needs. The device talks straight to Fastmail; there is no JMAP Connect server.
- Gravatar (gravatar.com) for senders' profile pictures. This can be turned off in Settings.
- Pictures inside emails load from the senders' own web servers, as in any email app. This can be turned off in Settings.
No analytics, advertising, AI, payment or other sign in services are used.

4. REGIONS
The app works the same in every region where it's offered. There are no regional differences in features or content.

5. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD PARTY MATERIAL
Not applicable. JMAP Connect is an independent app. It uses Fastmail's public JMAP API, which Fastmail documents for third party apps at fastmail.com/dev. It isn't made by or affiliated with Fastmail, and the listing says so. It contains no third party content.
